commands.title: Mathematical Function Analyser
commands.languageAlready: The language is already set to British English.

main.welcomeTitle: Welcome to the Mathematical Function Analyser!
main.welcomeDescription: This program analyses functions of the types constant, affine, quadratic, exponential, logarithmic, sine, cosine, tangent, etc. — identifying their properties and characteristics. To get started, enter the function data when prompted.
main.documentDescription: Mathematical Function Analyser developed in JavaScript and TypeScript.
main.noteCapitalized:
Note₁: This setting will make text “normal”, i.e., the first letter of each sentence capitalised and the rest lowercase
Note₂: This setting will disable “uppercase” and “lowercase”
main.noteUppercase:
Note₁: This setting will transform all letters to uppercase
Note₂: This setting will disable “capitalised” and “lowercase”
main.noteLowercase:
Note₁: This setting will transform all letters to lowercase
Note₂: This setting will disable “capitalised” and “uppercase”
